arguments.command:
python -c "
from parse import Parser
# Test various malformed inputs
test_cases = [
    '{abc',       # missing closing brace
    'abc}',       # unmatched closing brace  
    '{{abc',      # double open, missing close
    'abc}}',      # text then double close
    '{a{b}',      # nested braces (not supported)
    '{}{',        # valid field followed by orphan {
    '{',          # just an open brace
    '}',          # just a close brace
    '{{',         # double open (escaped)
    '}}',         # double close (escaped)
]

for tc in test_cases:
    try:
        p = Parser(tc)
        print(f'{repr(tc):20} -> expression: {repr(p._expression)}')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'{repr(tc):20} -> Error: {type(e).__name__}: {e}')
" 2>&1 | grep -v SyntaxWarning
